title: Agent Skill Runtime Attestation
description: Schema for privileged runtime host enforcement attestation

enforcedControls.description: Controls in force. 'os-sandbox-strict' (Claude Code sandbox, strict mode) and 'cloud-network-allowlist' (cloud session with an allowlisted network) confine scripts and child processes and count as interception.

networkInterceptionEnabled.description: The privileged host intercepts every outbound request of the skill, including from its scripts.

directEgressBlocked.description: Outbound connections that bypass the gate are refused.

bundleIntegrityEnabled.description: The host verifies the bundle hash before loading the skill.

quarantineRevocationEnabled.description: Network access is revoked when the skill is quarantined.
